title: Chapter 10 The End Of The Bugbears
content:
Chapter 10 The End Of The Bugbears

The town where Hu Tu is located is not far from here.

It is a small town with a population of less than 3,000 people, and is protected by a demon dog-headed lord.

This dog-headed lord is a typical second-generation lord. He inherited this small territory through the relationship of his elders, and he came here to eat and wait for death.

The defeat in the front war made this place the frontline area of the war between the native race and the foreign race, breaking the peace of this small territory.

The dog-headed lord learned that he could not continue to lie flat, and struggled for a while. Yesterday, he sent out the militia he had recruited to fight the invading greenskins.

The result was a complete defeat.

Wu Qing personally experienced this war.

As Wu Qing expected, there were few people who escaped back from the battlefield, and it also brought great panic to the entire territory.

Now the entire territory is in panic, and those who have the ability to rush to other territories began to evacuate early this morning.

Hu Tu ran here to scout the enemy situation, not on anyone's orders, but on his own initiative. He is a young man with ideals.

This is also the reason why he has some understanding of the lord's situation. He is a thoughtful person.

"Everyone else is preparing to escape, but you are still here? You have good courage!"

Wu Qing couldn't help but give Hu Tu a thumbs up.

"My family has passed down some skills. I just want to verify it. If things can't be done, I will also run away."

Hu Tu was praised by Wu Qing and suddenly became a little shy.

"Don't worry now. Although I am just one person, the tribe of my Zerg friends is very powerful."

"Those greenskinned people are fighting with Zerg friends. It's only a matter of time before they are destroyed."

Wu Qing said with a smile.

Hu Tu said in surprise: "I didn't expect that Zerg friends are so powerful that they can even defeat the orthodox foreign race such as the Bugbears protected by the evil god!"

"Are these greenskinned people Bugbears?"

Wu Qing finally knew the name of the greenskinned people's race.

"Yes, the bear goblins are one of the mainstream groups among the alien races. They believe in the spirit god, one of the many evil gods, and their race is very powerful."

"..."

Under Wu Qing's guidance, the two chatted very well, and Wu Qing got a lot of important information from Hu Tu.

I don't know whether the native races in this world are very united under the dual oppression of weirdness and alien races, or because Hu Tu, a young fox, is not experienced in the world, he seems very simple.

Hu Tu trusts Wu Qing very much, and he believes whatever Wu Qing says.

At this time, the bear goblin army at the edge of the forest has not waited for the news of the scouts and is preparing to evacuate.

"Brother Wu, those bear goblins are ready to withdraw!"

Hu Tu has already started to call Wu Qing brother.

"Don't worry, my friends are ready, we just need to watch here."

The two stopped chatting and turned their attention to the situation of the bear goblins.

During the time of chatting with Hu Tu, Wu Qing was secretly preparing to take the initiative to attack the bear goblin army.

If we leave the troops that escaped unattacked and wait for the enemy to return to the camp and hold out before forcing an attack, the price we pay will be even greater.

The opportunity cannot be missed. Whether or not we can completely destroy the enemy, we should fight them first.

The initiative of the war is now in Wu Qing's hands.

Eight mother nests can produce troops at the same time, and a batch of 16 puppies or 8 hydralisks can be produced in two minutes. As long as there are sufficient resources, the speed of producing troops is very fast.

In just such a short time, the resources accumulated by killing more than 300 bugbears in the morning have been exhausted.

At this time, the number of puppies has increased to 350, and the number of hydralisks has increased to 60.

A team of 3 hosts flew close to the treetops to the vicinity of the gathering place of the Zerg troops.

Everything is ready.

Hu Tu followed Wu Qing and quietly observed the movements of the bugbear army.

He saw that the bugbear troops reorganized and began to turn around and retreat.

This bear goblin army is not elite, and now they are not facing the enemy, so the adjustment of their entire marching team seems to be quite chaotic.

Just when the entire bear goblin team completely turned around, a huge roar came from the direction of the forest.

"Boom!"

More than 300 hideous and terrifying puppies with a body size of more than 2 meters rushed out of the forest.

The upgraded metabolically enhanced puppies are very fast, like a black torrent, rushing to the back of the bear goblin team.

"The friends of the Zerg are really fierce!"

Hu Tu looked at this scene excitedly, looking eager to try, and seemed to want to rush and kill.

The bear goblin army has a spirit god priest sitting in front of them. They seem to be able to feel the gaze of the spirit god at all times, and their mental state is very fanatical and excited.

"Stop advancing! Stay in place and fight!"

The bear goblin knight shouted the order loudly.

Although the formation of the bear goblin army was messy at this time, the individual state was not bad. It is really hard to say who will beat whom when ordinary armies encounter them.

However, Zerg, a group of creatures, is more terrifying than the followers of gods.

The bugbear army lined up on the spot, ready to meet the attack of the puppies.

The attack of the puppies was completely suicidal. They found a direction and rushed into the bugbear army without any hesitation.

The bloody and primitive melee began.

Nearly 60 hydralisks were slightly slower. They followed the puppies and launched a long-range attack on the bugbear army that was rushed into several sections.

With each volley, a large number of bugbears fell.

Three Hosts followed from behind and hovered not far from the battlefield.

"Throw stones!"

The number of the Bugbear army still had an advantage, and the individual combat power was not weak. The soldiers at the back of the battlefield who were not impacted could still organize a large-scale stone throwing attack.

The Zerg with upgraded armor were almost immune to this attack.

The thrown stones hit the puppies and hydralisks, but could not destroy their hard insect armor.

"Brother Wu! Can our Zerg friends win?"

The cruel war scene cooled Hu Tu's blood a little, and he began to worry about the victory or defeat on the battlefield.

He had seen many life and death scenes, but this was the first time he had seen such a scene.

"Don't worry, our Zerg friends are very powerful and will definitely win!"

Wu Qing smiled and comforted.

Seeing Wu Qing's relaxed look, Hu Tu admired him from the bottom of his heart.

On the battlefield, more than 300 puppies fighting head-on may not be able to beat more than 600 strong fanatical Bugbears, but the long-range attack of 60 hydralisks is really terrifying.

A frontal volley can kill or injure dozens of people. Even if the battlefield situation is complicated at this time, each volley can kill at least a dozen bugbears.

The bugbears that are close want to rush over for close-range attacks, but they can't withstand the concentrated fire of the hydralisks.

Even if they rush over, the 3-meter-tall hydralisks are not afraid. In reality, they are not like the setting in the game, without any attack ability against close targets. Their minions and tails are not decorations.

"Protect the priest!"

Seeing that the situation on the battlefield is out of control, all the knights among the bugbears move closer to the priest in the center of the army and guard beside the huge lizard.

Other bugbears are also consciously gathering in the center for defense.

The white-robed bugbear priest looks at the dead bugbears and puppies on the battlefield all turning into light and disappearing, with a solemn expression.

"Is this the mysterious race that is against the spirit god?"

He looks at the bugbears that are constantly dying, and feels that he is at the end of his rope.
